recent_articles.title: For every job at Mazagon Dock, 6.4 jobs are created across economy: Captain Jagmohan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Captain Jagmohan (Retd.)**, Chairman and Managing Director of **Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL)**, stated that one direct job at MDL generates six and a half jobs across India. He cited the Project 17A frigate as an example, where 4,500 MDL workers support nearly 28,000 positions in ancillary industries. The **Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision (MAKV)** aims to place India among the top five shipbuilding countries by 2047 with a target of 4.5 million gross tonnage and an expected investment of ₹4.5 lakh crore.

recent_articles.title: ‘Development is not about factories or roads; we must connect with people’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Eknath Shinde**, Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister, emphasized the importance of infrastructure development in Maoist-affected areas during a session at The Hindu's 'Maharashtra Infrastructure Conclave 2026'. He highlighted the significance of projects like Surjagadh in Gadchiroli and discussed the government's rehabilitation strategy for these regions.  **Vinaya Deshpande**, Chief of the Bureau, Maharashtra, moderated the session titled "Mumbai to Surjagadh: Expressway to Prosperity".

recent_articles.title: Rajasthan Cabinet approves new industrial development policy with focus on talent economy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rajasthan** Cabinet approved a new industrial development policy focused on talent economy and private sector participation to create a world-class industrial infrastructure.  **Industries and Commerce Minister Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore** stated the policy would provide incentives for micro, small, and medium enterprises, one district one product, and the export sector. The policy aims to boost the state's economy to $350 billion by 2028-29.  The Cabinet also approved decisions on energy production, water conservation, and pensioners' welfare.

recent_articles.title: Mumbai, Maharashtra emerging as key hubs for global investment and clean energy partnerships, say diplomats - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Consul Generals** from **Australia** and **Finland** highlighted the growing investment opportunities in Mumbai and Maharashtra, emphasizing infrastructure development, clean energy, education, and technology sectors.  They praised Mumbai's transformation, citing projects like the Coastal Road and metro expansion as drivers of investor confidence. Both diplomats acknowledged challenges faced by foreign investors, including regulatory clarity and streamlined approval systems. Despite these challenges, they expressed optimism about Mumbai's long-term trajectory as a global economic hub.

recent_articles.title: Infrastructure is foundation of economic growth, says M. Jamshed - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M. Jamshed**, during a special address at **The Hindu’s Maharashtra Infrastructure Conclave 2026**, highlighted the crucial role of infrastructure in development, emphasizing its importance for India's economic growth. He praised **Maharashtra** as a leading example of infrastructure development from Delhi's perspective and expressed optimism about the state's continued success.  **Mr. Jamshed** noted that the Centre's focus on integrated infrastructure development since 2014 has expanded beyond traditional sectors, encompassing physical, digital, and social infrastructure. He emphasized core sectors like roads, railways, maritime transport, and energy alongside digital and social infrastructure segments such as rural drinking water, sanitation, and water resource management.

recent_articles.title: After High Court verdict, Hindu petitioners seek free entry for devotees at Bhojshala in Madhya Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hindu** petitioners have filed applications with the **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)** and the **Union Culture Ministry**, demanding free entry to the Bhojshala complex and the removal of "unauthorised Islamic symbols". They also requested that idols of Lord Hanuman and other Hindu deities be retrieved through a scientific excavation. The **Madhya Pradesh High Court** had declared the site a Vagdevi temple on May 15, quashing an earlier order allowing Muslims to offer namaz there.

recent_articles.title: Manoj Jarange warns of fresh agitation over Maratha quota issue from May 30 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Manoj Jarange**, a Maratha quota activist, announced an indefinite hunger strike beginning May 30th over the **Maharashtra** government's failure to distribute Kunbi caste certificates and implement other demands.  Jarange demanded the dissolution of the Maratha quota sub-committee and urged for a separate ministry for the Maratha and Kunbi communities. He also criticized the state government for halting the issuance of Kunbi caste certificates, claiming that officials have been instructed not to issue them. **Devendra Fadnavis**, the Chief Minister of **Maharashtra**, has been accused by Jarange of being responsible for these actions.

recent_articles.title: CBI arrests ‘mastermind’ linked to NEET-UG 2026 biology paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** arrested a biology lecturer, **Manisha Gurunath Mandhare**, for her involvement in the 2026 NEET-UG paper leak case.  **Mandhare**, appointed by the **National Testing Agency (NTA)** as an expert, allegedly disclosed questions and answers from botany and zoology subjects to students through special coaching classes at her residence. The agency has arrested nine individuals in connection with the case, including a chemistry lecturer, **P.V. Kulkarni**, who allegedly leaked chemistry questions.  The CBI is conducting searches across the country and investigating leads related to the distribution of a "guess" paper that closely matched the actual exam paper.

recent_articles.title: Psychiatrist and writer Anand Nadkarni passes away - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dr. Anand Nadkarni**, a psychiatrist and founder of the Institute for Psychological Health in Thane, passed away on May 15, 2026, at the age of 66.  He was diagnosed with a pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor in March and underwent multiple surgeries. **Dr. Nadkarni** dedicated his life to mental health awareness, addiction treatment, literature, and theatre. He founded the IPH in Thane in 1990, which later became an educational center affiliated with several universities.  He also established the Muktangan Addiction Detoxification Centre in Pune. His work was recognized through numerous awards and publications, including his books "Gadhepanchavishi" and "Vishadayoga," which received recognition from the Maharashtra government. **Dr. Nadkarni** was a prolific writer and contributed to Marathi films and music. He also conducted online and offline mental health awareness activities during the Covid-19 pandemic.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra government forwards proposal for Padma Vibhushan to Khashaba Jadhav - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Maharashtra** government has proposed the Padma Vibhushan award to deceased wrestler **Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav**, who won a bronze medal at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics. The government also stated it will submit proposals for the 2027 Padma Awards before the July 31 deadline.  The **Bombay High Court** had previously asked the government to decide on the award after Jadhav's death, and accepted the state government's submission in May.

recent_articles.title: Sebi approves IPO plans of Neolite Lightings, Aspri Spirits and SS Retail - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Neolite ZKW Lightings**, a manufacturer of automotive lighting products, plans to raise Rs 600 crore through a combination of fresh issue and offer-for-sale. The IPO will be used for setting up a greenfield manufacturing facility in Kancheepuram, Tamil Nadu, expanding existing operations, and repaying borrowings. **Neolite ZKW Lightings** has a significant market share in India's commercial vehicle lighting segment and serves over 40 OEM customers. Meanwhile, **Aspri Spirits**, an importer and distributor of international wine and spirits, received Sebi approval for its public issue with a proposed IPO of up to Rs 140 crore.  SS Retail, another company seeking regulatory clearance, plans to raise Rs 500 crore through its IPO, which will be used for expansion and growth.

recent_articles.title: Tell your ‘petty politicians’ not to blame the court for delay, CJI tells Thackeray-Shinde factions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** expressed frustration with the "petty politicians" of the Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde factions of the Shiv Sena for making accusations against the court regarding delays in their dispute over the party symbol.  Chief Justice of India Surya Kant criticized the parties' media statements, urging them to refrain from such actions. Senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi, representing the Shinde faction, acknowledged that irresponsible comments were made and urged the court to set a specific date for final arguments. The case, which has been pending for years, centers on the Election Commission's February 2023 order assigning the symbol 'bow and arrow' to the Shinde faction, challenging the Thackeray faction's claim to the party name and symbol.

recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis’ bike ride draws Opposition ire - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, rode a motorbike to Vidhan Bhavan after Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** called for austerity measures. The move drew criticism from the Opposition who urged Ministers to use public transport instead.  **Sharad Pawar**, NCP SP president, questioned the timing of the austerity measures and demanded an all-party meeting with the Prime Minister. He also criticized the State Government ministers' language towards **Rahul Gandhi**, the Leader of Opposition in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.

recent_articles.title: ATS questions 57 in Maharashtra over alleged gangster network links - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS)** officials conducted searches across several cities in the state as part of an operation targeting alleged networks linked to Pakistani gangsters, including the Shahzad Bhatti gang and the Dogra gang. The focus is on identifying sleeper cells, local operatives, and support systems that may facilitate arms smuggling or conspiracies.  **ATS** teams seized electronic devices and are examining bank accounts and financial transactions to determine if funds were routed from Pakistan through hawala channels.

recent_articles.title: School education index: Kerala betters grade, score - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite the denial of funds by the **Union government**, **Kerala** has improved its performance in the **Union Ministry of Education’s Performance Grading Index 2.0 for States/Union Territories (UT) for the year 2024-25**. The state received a Prachesta-2 grade, an improvement from Prachesta-3 in 2023-24, with scores rising from 594.2 to 687.7.  **Kerala** achieved the topmost Utkarsh grade (72.8-80) in access and the Uttam-1 grade (81-90.9) in teacher education and training, among other achievements. The report highlights Kerala's progress despite challenges, including a lack of funding from the **Union government**.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: Over ₹1 crore cash, AK-47 rifles recovered from Maoist hideouts, say police - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** in **Narayanpur district**, **Chhattisgarh**, have recovered over ₹1.01 crore in cash and a significant amount of arms and ammunition, including AK-47 and SLR rifles, from former Maoist hideouts or dumps in the past month.  The largest recovery was made on May 9th at Nelangur village near the Chhattisgarh-Maharashtra border, where ₹84 lakh in cash was found alongside two AK-47 rifles.

recent_articles.title: NEET-UG examination 2026: One suspect arrested from Nashik - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Testing Agency (NTA)** cancelled the NEET-UG examination for 2026 after an alleged paper leak, leading to the arrest of a suspect in **Maharashtra**. The Rajasthan Police requested the **Maharashtra police** to detain the individual who was apprehended after changing his appearance.  The cancellation has drawn criticism from opposition leaders, including **Rohit Pawar**, who pointed out that the state government's new law against paper leaks is insufficient and called for stricter action against those involved. A CBI inquiry into the matter has been initiated.

recent_articles.title: A society at large under question: rebuild a culture where safety of children is collective responsibility - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **three- to four-year-old girl** was allegedly sexually assaulted and murdered in Maharashtra's Pune district, highlighting the fragility of social trust and safety for children. The incident has prompted calls for a more comprehensive approach to dealing with repeat sexual offenders, including stricter parole restrictions, enhanced monitoring by law enforcement, and expedited justice processes.  The **National Commission for Women** is working closely with authorities to ensure a timely investigation and swift proceedings.

recent_articles.title: Assam swearing-in LIVE: Himanta Biswa Sarma takes oath as Assam CM; Four MLAs sworn in as Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma** was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Assam for a second consecutive term on Tuesday, May 2, 2026. **Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya** administered the oath of office at a ceremony held at the Veterinary Ground in Guwahati.  Joining **Sarma** were four other MLAs who took oaths as Ministers: **Rameswar Teli**, **Ajanta Neog**, **Atul Bora**, and **Charan Boro**. The event was attended by prominent figures including **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, Nitin Gadkari, Sarbananda Sonowal, Pabitra Margherita**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin**. This marks the formation of a third successive NDA government in the state.

recent_articles.title: Union Minister Pemmasani urges Nitin Gadkari to resolve traffic woes at Guntur bypass - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani**, Union Minister of State for Rural Development and Communications, met with **Nitin Gadkari**, Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways, to address traffic congestion and road safety concerns at the Chinnakakani junction near Kaza tollgate on the Guntur-Vijayawada National Highway.  **Pemmasani** requested the Ministry to construct either a grade-separated interchange or a uni-directional flyover to improve vehicular movement and enhance commuter safety. **Gadkari** responded positively, directing officials to examine the issue and initiate necessary action.

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is set to begin phase three of its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list process in the coming days, covering nearly 40 crore electors across 17 states and five UTs.  This follows completion of SIR in 10 states and three UTs previously, which has successfully removed over 60 lakh deceased voters from the rolls. The ECI had initially delayed the rollout due to Assembly elections in several states but is now proceeding with the revision process.  The exercise aims to ensure accurate voter lists for upcoming elections.

recent_articles.title: TCS Nashik case: NCW flags ‘toxic work culture’, ‘zero POSH compliance’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **National Commission for Women (NCW)** has found that **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** in Nashik is failing to comply with the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Act, citing pervasive harassment, religious denigration, and systemic bullying. The NCW's fact-finding committee observed that victims were intimidated into silence due to a lack of formal complaint mechanisms and a toxic workplace environment.  The committee has recommended action for TCS’ failure to comply with the POSH Act, as well as measures to protect complainants and ensure a safe working environment.

recent_articles.title: Governor’s role in government formation | Explained - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)** secured a majority in the recent Tamil Nadu Assembly elections, but the Governor invited the party's chief to form the government.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the TVK leader, was sworn in as Chief Minister after securing letters of support from 120 members. The Governor's discretion in appointing the Chief Minister is based on constitutional provisions and previous recommendations by commissions, but there have been instances where Governors have appointed a Chief Minister without following these guidelines.  The Supreme Court has emphasized that the "floor of the House" is the appropriate forum to determine majority support for a government.

recent_articles.title: Rupali Chakankar appears before SIT in 'godman' Kharat case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rupali Chakankar**, NCP leader and former State women’s panel chief, appeared before the special investigation team (SIT) in Nashik to answer questions about her alleged association with self-styled godman **Ashok Kharat**.  Ms. Chakankar resigned from both positions following revelations of her ties to **Kharat**, who is currently under arrest for rape and sexual exploitation. The Maharashtra Government has set up an SIT to investigate 12 cases against **Kharat** in Nashik and Ahilyanagar districts, with the SIT likely to question Ms. Chakankar about her connection to him.  Senior Congress leader **Nana Patole** alleged that **Kharat**’s life is in danger in prison and demanded the removal of four ministers connected to him from the state cabinet.

recent_articles.title: Ministers, ambassadors, artists to join The Hindu’s Huddle in June - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Hindu Group** is hosting its annual **The Hindu Huddle**, a conference focused on global issues, in Bengaluru from June 5th to 6th. This year's theme, "A World in Transition," will feature discussions on topics such as regional parties in Indian democracy, diplomacy and conflict resolution, women's representation in Parliament, the role of AI, mental health, and the future of work.  The event will include prominent speakers from India and around the world, including Union Ministers Hardeep Puri and Nitin Gadkari, former President Mohamed Nasheed, and Chinese Ambassador Xu Feihong.

recent_articles.title: Gram panchayat elections in Karnataka will be held before end of 2026, says Minister Priyank Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Priyank Kharge**, **Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Minister**, announced that the state government will hold gram panchayat elections before the end of the year.  He also stated that drinking water scarcity in Kalaburagi district is being addressed with funds from the state government, the Kalyana Karnataka Region Development Board, and recommendations from task forces headed by MLAs. **Mr. Kharge** added that a decision on expanding the State Cabinet will be made at the appropriate time by **Chief Minister Siddaramaiah** and the party high command.

recent_articles.title: NCP(SP) leader splashed with ink by right-wing preacher - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vikas Lawande**, spokesperson for the **NCP(SP)**, was allegedly attacked with black ink in Pune, Maharashtra on Saturday by a group led by right-wing preacher **Sangram Bhandare**. The attack followed **Lawande's** remarks about **Bhandare's** gurus, who are part of the Warkari movement.  **Lawande** reported the incident to the police and demanded action against the attackers. Several political leaders, including **Shashikant Shinde**, **Mehbub Shaikh**, and **Vijay Wadettiwar**, condemned the attack and called for protection of free speech.
